Is a Hard Drive Enough for GTA 6? Store vs. Play Before You Spend a Dime 💾

post // Nov 20, 2026

Read more on Threads

Hold up. Before you grab the first "gaming drive" you see this Black Friday, answer one question: do you need to store games, or play them? 💾

GTA 6 asks PS5 players to clear up to 212 GB. That's a big bite out of any console. But your fix might cost nothing, and the cheapest fix isn't always the one people think.

Step 1: the free fix

Open Settings → Storage on your PS5 and look at what's actually installed. If there are games you haven't touched in months, delete them. You can download them again later, and PlayStation's guide shows how to keep your saved data safe. PlayStation: manage your PS5 storage

Got enough room now? Then you're done. Keep your money.

Storage check / PS5

Is a hard drive enough?

Store ✔

A USB hard drive can hold your games

Move the PS5 games you're not playing onto a USB hard drive (or USB SSD), and GTA 6 gets the room on your console. PS4 games can even play straight from it.

Play ✘

It can't run your PS5 games

PS5 games can't be played from USB. When you want one back, copy it to the console storage and play it from there.

PlayStation's rules for USB extended storage: SuperSpeed USB 5 Gbps or faster, 250 GB to 8 TB, plugged straight into the console (no USB hub), and one extended-storage drive at a time. PlayStation: USB extended storage on PS5.

When you actually need an SSD

Want a bunch of PS5 games installed and ready to play at once, no copying back and forth? That's when you need an internal M.2 SSD with a heatsink. It goes inside the console and works like more living room.

How to install it →

Usable space is lower than the advertised capacity. Check the exact model, seller and today's price before buying, and follow Sony's M.2 SSD installation guide for your console.

Black Friday, real talk

Prices move all weekend, and a "deal" isn't a deal if you didn't need the thing. We're not going to tell you anything is the lowest price ever. Check today's price, check who the seller is, and if you already have the room, walk away.

Buying for a GTA 6 player?

Don't guess. Ask them one question: "How much free space is on your PS5?" If they're close to full, storage is a gift they'll actually use. If they've got plenty of room, get them something else.

Quick answers

Can a PS5 play games from an external hard drive? Not PS5 games. A USB drive can store them, but you copy a game back to the console to play it. PS4 games can play from USB.

Do I need an SSD for GTA 6? Only if you can't make enough room. Check Settings → Storage and clear what you're not playing first.

Hard drive or SSD for USB storage? Both work for parking games. A USB SSD copies games back faster; a hard drive usually costs less per terabyte.

Can I put any M.2 SSD in a PS5? Not any. It has to fit Sony's requirements and needs a heatsink. Follow Sony's guide for your console model.
